key_concepts: Plants have common parts: roots, stems, and leaves.
Roots anchor the plant to the soil.
Roots absorb water from the soil.
Roots absorb nutrients from the soil.
Stems carry water and nutrients from roots to leaves.
Leaves get energy from the Sun to make food.
Some roots store food, such as carrots.
Cactus spines protect the plant from animals.
Different plants can have roots, stems, and leaves that look different.
Some plants have additional visible parts such as fruits or flowers.
Watering a wilted plant can help it recover because plants need water.
